sectionDescription: A time to reflect on the conversation and appreciate fellow participants.

items.title: Conversation reflections
content: How do we each feel about the conversation we’ve just had?
What did you learn about diverging perspectives and views?
What might you take away from this conversation?
items.guidance: Each participant chooses one of the reflection prompts to respond to.

items.title: Appreciation
content: Each participant mention something they appreciated about the conversation.
Every participant has the option to mention something they appreciated about the conversation.
items.guidance: Each participant chooses one of the appreciation prompts to respond to.
